name: WAI Play
tagline: AI web game testing and quality evaluation — an agent that plays your game and reports
description: WAI Play is an automatic playtesting and quality-diagnosis agent for vibe-coded web games. Give it a game URL (and optionally a ZIP of the source), and it operates the game in a real browser — keyboard, mouse, and game interfaces — to understand the goal, find problems, and record state, screenshots, and video evidence. It outputs a structured five-dimension quality score (core flow, core gameplay, UI/visuals, input feedback, technical stability), deduplicated problem cards with evidence, and plain-language fix suggestions. Optionally uploading the source ZIP lets it understand win conditions and route planning more accurately.
highlights: Plays web games in a real browser and records screenshots and video evidence
Five-dimension quality scoring: flow, gameplay, UI, feedback, stability
Deduplicated problem cards bound to the best attempt's evidence
Reprocesses and re-plans after failures instead of blindly retrying
Upload a source ZIP for more accurate win-condition understanding
curatorNote: Testing web games by hand is painfully slow, and WAI Play turns it into a repeatable agent flow with evidence you can actually show. The five-dimension scoring and re-planning loop are the right instincts for automated QA.
